Agent in Action

Ask. Get SQL. Get Answers.

Type a question in plain English — the agent writes and runs the SQL for you
Here the agent answers "How many orders are in the database? What is the total amount?" It introspects the schema, writes dialect-correct SQL, executes it, and returns the answer — live, in your terminal.
  • Reads your schema before writing any SQL
  • Streams SQL character-by-character as it thinks
  • Runs the query and surfaces the answer
  • No manual SQL needed

Overview

Three-Pane Layout

Chat · SQL whiteboard · Results · Schema — all visible at once
One terminal window keeps every piece of the workflow in sight: the agent's conversation on the left, the SQL it wrote in the center, the results below, and your live schema on the right.
  • Ctrl+1 → focus AI chat
  • Ctrl+2 → focus SQL editor
  • Ctrl+3 → focus results table
  • Ctrl+4 → focus schema browser
LabRat — Overview

SQL Whiteboard

The Agent's Whiteboard

Watch SQL stream into the editor as the agent thinks
The SQL editor is not just for you — it's the agent's working space. SQL streams in character-by-character as the agent reasons. You can edit it, run it manually, or ask the agent to revise it.
  • Agent writes SQL here in real time
  • Ctrl+Enter → run the query yourself
  • Edit agent SQL and re-run freely
  • Full syntax highlighting for every dialect
LabRat — SQL Whiteboard
4/13
Results

Query Results

Tabular output from the agent's SQL, ready to explore
After the agent runs its query the results appear here — scrollable, column-typed, row-counted. The agent reads these results to formulate its answer, and you can navigate them independently.
  • Ctrl+3 → focus and navigate results
  • Arrow keys to move between cells
  • Column widths auto-sized to content
  • Row count shown in pane header
LabRat — Results

Schema

Schema Browser

Live catalog of every table, column, and type
The right pane shows the full database catalog — introspected on connect and always visible. The agent uses this same catalog when deciding which tables to query.
  • Auto-introspects on connect
  • Expandable: schemas → tables → columns
  • Column types shown inline
  • Ctrl+H to hide for more editor space
LabRat — Schema

Threads

Thread Manager

Separate named sessions for each investigation
Each thread has its own AI conversation, query history, findings, and memories. Switch investigations without losing context — like branches for data work.
  • Ctrl+T → open thread manager
  • Create named threads per investigation
  • Switch without losing history
  • Each thread has independent AI context
LabRat — Threads

Findings

Pinned Findings

Key insights saved with provenance
When the agent surfaces something important it pins it as a Finding — a structured note with question, answer, and the exact SQL that produced it. Browse all findings with Ctrl+K.
  • Ctrl+K → open findings viewer
  • Agent pins insights automatically
  • Each finding links to source SQL
  • Persistent per thread across sessions

History

Query History

Every query logged with timestamps
All executed queries — by you or the agent — are logged automatically. Browse with Ctrl+R, see exactly when each ran, and re-run or copy any past query instantly.
  • Ctrl+R → open history browser
  • Timestamped, always-on JSONL log
  • Browse and re-run past queries
  • Scoped per thread
LabRat — History

Memory

Agent Memories

Gets smarter about your data over time
The agent writes memories as it learns — schema patterns, your corrections, business rules. Day-30 LabRat is meaningfully better than day-1. Browse all memories with Ctrl+G.
  • Ctrl+G → open memories viewer
  • Agent writes memories automatically
  • Scoped: global or per-table
  • Applied to every future query

Keyboard Shortcuts

Every command one key away

Focus Mode

Schema Hidden

More room when you need it
Ctrl+H toggles the schema pane off, expanding the editor and results to fill the terminal. Useful for wide result sets or long queries where you need the horizontal space.
  • Ctrl+H → toggle schema panel
  • Editor + results expand to fill
  • Schema remains loaded in memory
  • Toggle back instantly

Everything Together

One terminal, one tool, no context switching
LabRat is a fully keyboard-driven AI data agent that lives in your terminal. Connect to any warehouse, ask questions in plain English, and get answers backed by auditable SQL.
